verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document any Productboard feature that automatically notifies customers when the status of a feature they requested changes. Webhooks on entity changes and API links between feedback, customers and features are developer building blocks that could be used to build such notifications. They are not the capability itself. The "close the loop" claim concerns specs, shipping and outcomes, not customer notification.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically notify customers when the status of their requested feature changes
